verdict.rationale: Syncing payroll journal entries to accounting software is a fair question for a payroll product, but the evidence never mentions a QuickBooks, Xero, or general-ledger/journal-entry sync. The REST API, webhooks, and scheduled jobs are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
